text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated queue depth on embeddings-hot-route in us-west-2. Error rate for embeddings up to 4.8% for the last 5m. Auto-scaler lagging.

sara: Seeing correlated increase in chat tail latency on multi-turn sessions (p95 -> 1.8s). Looks like embeddings spike is saturating GPU pools used by both routes.

dan: Confirmed. Metrics: embeddings qdepth ~= 9k, chat p95 up 60ms->1.8s, rerank error 429s for some customers. Likely noisy embeddings batch workloads.

kai: Quick mitigation proposal: apply per-endpoint quota tweak to throttle embeddings route (lower qps) + set route-specific burst allowance for chat to preserve interactive latency. Also consider disabling non-critical rerank pipelines for now.

lisa: Agreed. Which knobs do we have live? I can change per-route quotas via admin API or use the traffic-shaper to limit embeddings concurrency.

dan: Admin API works. Commands:

```bash
# reduce embeddings route QPS to 30% of normal for public tenants
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/routes/embeddings-hot/adjust_quota \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \\
  -d '{"qps_pct": 30, "duration_sec": 1800, "reason": "protect-chat-latency"}'

# bump chat route priority token buckets for interactive sessions
curl -X POST https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/routes/chat/modify_tokens \\
  -d '{"extra_tokens": 200, "duration_sec": 1800, "scope": "interactive"}'
```

sara: I'll run the embeddings throttle now, dan please do chat token tweak if you can. I'll annotate the incident ticket.

dan: Running embeddings QPS change now.

oncall-bot: Command accepted by admin-api, request id abc123.

dan: embeddings QPS set to 30% (req abc123). Monitoring.

kai: I also pushed a temporary rule in traffic-shaper to cap concurrent embeddings batches to 16 per-gpu. Should reduce queue growth.

lisa: Noticed immediate drop in embeddings qdepth to ~3.2k after throttle + cap. Chat p95 trending back down (now 420ms). Good sign.

maria: Rerank pipeline: toggled non-enterprise rerank to "disabled" for 30m via feature-flag. That should cut some load.

sara: Customer impact summary so far: ~8 customers on embeddings-heavy workloads saw 5-8% failed embedding calls (retries in client mitigated some). Two midsize customers reported chat sluggishness for 20-30m. No widespread data loss.

dan: On-call handoff: sara -> dan for active mitigation phase. After 30m, dan -> kai for recovery and postmortem work.

kai: I'll keep monitoring for 45m. If error rate doesn't drop below 0.5% we'll revert rerank change and iterate.

lisa: Post-incident actions: collect top 50 slow traces, run eval on embeddings batch sizes, propose permanent route-specific quotas, and add automated circuit-breaker for heavy embedding batches. Assigning owner: kai.

maria: I'll notify the two affected customers with a short summary and mitigation ETA.

sara: Thanks team. Marking this as "live mitigation in progress" in the incident tracker. Will update when we start recovery. :thumbsup:
